title: Virtual Assistant Ecommerce Brand D2C (Customer Support, Operations & AI)
description:
Are YOU an experienced ecommerce support professional who can answer a difficult customer with care, and also keep an eye on orders, suppliers and stock like the founder's right hand? Can you use Claude to automate repetitive work, and take initiative without waiting to be told? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.



We run multiple international ecommerce brands selling both digital products (ebooks, templates, online courses) and physical products, primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for an Ecommerce Virtual Assistant who will handle customer support and follow our day-to-day operations, as a true right hand to the founder.



This is not a role where you answer tickets and wait for instructions. Customer support is a core part of the job, but when the inbox is quiet you move on to operations, suppliers and projects.



We need someone to take responsibility for:



Customer Support: Handling our support inbox end-to-end (order issues, shipping and delivery questions, missing downloads, billing, refund requests, product questions) as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand.

Retention & Disputes: Offering the right solution before any refund, per our SOP, and responding quickly to chargebacks and payment disputes with the right evidence.

Operations Follow-Up: Following orders, stock levels and delivery issues, spotting problems before customers do, and keeping a simple daily log of what needs attention.

Supplier Communication: Talking to our suppliers about stock, deliveries and problems, following up, and negotiating when needed.

Automation: Using Claude, Claude Code, connectors and other tools to automate repetitive tickets and manual tasks, and proposing new automations on your own initiative.

AI Content Support: Creating product and marketing images with ChatGPT (or similar tools), producing ebooks with Claude, and generating interactive content with AppLovin tools.

Founder Support: Taking over tasks the founder currently does by hand, and anticipating what's needed next.



Position Requirements:



At least 2 years of customer support experience in ecommerce. You have answered real customer tickets for real stores. Experience with dispute/chargeback handling and with digital products is a plus.

Experience in other ecommerce tasks: you have worked on at least some of these for previous companies: supplier communication, stock or inventory, order management, product listings, ads support, store operations. Tell us exactly what you've done.

Hands-on experience with Claude: you use it regularly for real work. Experience with Claude Code, connectors or automations is strongly preferred, and you'll be asked to describe real examples.

Experience with AI image generation (ChatGPT or similar) for product or marketing visuals.

Initiative and ownership: you notice problems, propose solutions and often build them yourself.

Excellent written English: warm, natural and professional.

Comfortable with ecommerce tools: a helpdesk (Gorgias or similar), Shopify, Google Drive, and order tracking platforms.

Reliability: customers and suppliers depend on you, so consistency matters more than anything on a CV. Starting part-time, with room to grow toward full-time.

Precision: correct order numbers, correct links, no copy-paste mistakes.



What We Offer:



A complete Customer Service SOP with templates and escalation guidelines, so you're never guessing.

A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment.

Real growth: more responsibility, more hours and performance-based rate increases as the role expands.

Ownership and variety: you'll work with the AI stack, build automations and see the results of your ideas inside a real, growing business.



Screening Questions (Upwork):



How many years have you answered customer tickets in ecommerce? Which stores or types of products, which channels 
, chat) and which tools? Have you handled disputes/chargebacks, and on digital products, physical products or both? In your experience, how many tickets can one person realistically handle in an 8-hour day, and what does that number depend on?

Besides answering customers, which other tasks have you done for previous companies (suppliers, stock, orders, listings, ads, images, ebooks, automations, operations)? For each one, tell us how long you did it and give one concrete example of what you handled.

Have you used Claude, Claude Code or other tools to automate a business process? Describe one real example: what it did, how you built it, and the result.



To Apply: Please answer the screening questions above directly in your application, with specific examples. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short application form.

title: emote Home Care Scheduler, Recruiter, and Intake Coordinator WITH HOMECARE EXPERIENCE
description:
About us

ComForCare is a home care agency that provides in-home care to seniors across several counties in New Jersey. At its core, our business is recruiting great caregivers and matching them with the clients who need them. We have a culture that values teamwork, learning and professional growth.

About the role

You will keep our caregivers hired and scheduled. You will recruit and onboard new caregivers, and fill and manage shifts so every client is covered.

This role suits someone who stays calm when a caregiver calls off at the last minute, and who follows up with every applicant, every time.

What you will do

Scheduling (daily)

• Match caregivers to client shifts based on skills, location and availability.

• Keep every client’s schedule fully covered: handle call-offs, last-minute changes and shift swaps.

• Answer calls and texts from caregivers, clients and families about schedules, with patience and professionalism.

• Enter and update schedules, caregiver records and client records in our home care software (SwyftOps).

• Review and close out the previous day’s shifts so visit records are complete.

Recruiting and onboarding (daily and weekly)

• Post and refresh caregiver job ads each week on Indeed and other job sites.

• Contact applicants by phone, text and
, screen them, and schedule interviews.

• Follow up with missed and inactive applicants.

• Walk new hires through applications, background checks and hiring paperwork.

• Every Friday, check that each caregiver’s required documents (certifications, health records, licenses) are received, accurate and current.

• Track recruiting results and work toward a monthly hiring goal.

How we measure success

• Every client shift covered, with call-offs filled quickly.

• New caregivers hired and fully onboarded each month, against a monthly goal.

• Caregiver files complete and current.

title: Reddit Community Marketer (3 posts/day, 7 days a week)
description:

title: Revenue Management Assistant (Short-Term Rentals) – Full Time
description:
We're looking for a sharp revenue management assistant who learns new systems fast, is comfortable talking to clients, and can contribute from day one.



RevWhisper prices and manages listings for short-term rental owners across Airbnb, Vrbo and 
. We manage 250+ homes across the US and Canada and add 10 to 20 more every week. We're hiring full-time assistants to do hands-on pricing work and client support alongside our revenue managers.



You'll work across pricing tools (mainly PriceLabs), property management systems (Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez and others), Airbnb, Vrbo, and our own internal software. You'll also talk directly with our clients, the owners of these homes. Experience with a dynamic pricing tool is a big plus, but what matters most is how you think: you pick up new software quickly, solve problems on your own, explain things clearly, and catch mistakes before they cost an owner money.



You'll be contributing from day one. We're not looking for long ramp-up times. We want people who hit the ground running.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Pricing

- Check occupancy, booking pace, ADR and forward calendars, and flag weak or high-demand dates

- Make approved pricing changes: minimum stays, orphan gaps, seasonal settings, date overrides, min/base/max prices

- Check every change landed correctly in the PMS and on Airbnb/Vrbo

- Spot sync problems and wrong price floors, and raise them before changing more

- Keep change logs and spreadsheets accurate



Clients

- Answer client
s and texts promptly and clearly

- Get on the phone with clients and explain pricing decisions and results in plain words

- Troubleshoot client issues, from booking questions to listing and calendar problems, and follow through until they're fixed

- Know when to bring in a revenue manager, and hand over the full picture when you do



Tools

- Use AI tools for research, writing and spreadsheet work, and check their output before acting

- Learn new tools and our internal software quickly, and suggest better ways of working



MUST HAVE

- Hands-on experience with short-term rental pricing tools or property management systems (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond, Guesty, Hostaway or similar)

- Comfortable getting on the phone with clients and explaining decisions, including when they're upset

- Clear written and spoken English

- A track record of learning new software quickly

- Strong spreadsheet skills and attention to detail

- Reliable internet and power backup; available for your agreed shift, including weekends or nights if that's your schedule



NICE TO HAVE

- Hands-on PriceLabs experience on live listings

- Client-facing experience with property owners, hosts or guests

- Experience supporting a revenue manager across a portfolio of homes

- Airbnb, Vrbo or 
 experience



WHAT YOU GET

- USD 7–12 per hour, based on skill and experience, paid monthly

- Flexible shifts: weekday, weekend or night (US/Canada daytime hours also available)

- Long-term, full-time work with a fast-growing team

- Room to grow: strong assistants take on more homes, more clients and more responsibility



Not a fit: hotel revenue management backgrounds only, without short-term rental work.



HIRING STEPS

1. Apply (see below)

2. Short written screening form: five pricing scenarios and a few questions about you

3. Video call where you walk us through a pricing tool you've used and handle a mock client call



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "PRICING". Tell us about one pricing change you made on a live listing and why, one piece of software you learned quickly and how, and which shifts you can work (weekday, weekend, night).

title: Short-Form Video Editor / Clipping Specialist
description:
About Us

Slimeatory is a vibrant, fast-growing global brand dedicated to all things slime! We produce engaging, satisfying content for millions of followers across YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, while delivering top-tier slime products to our community.



We are a creative, fast-paced team that loves riding social media trends and bringing joy to our audience. If you live and breathe short-form content and want to work with a massively popular brand, we'd love to have you on board.



The Role

We are hiring a shar-eyed Video Editor who specializes in clipping. Your primary mission is to sift through our long-form videos, livestreams, and raw footage to transform them into viral-worthy short-form clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube shorts.



What You'll Be Doing:

- Review long-form videos and raw footage to identify standout, "golden" moments.

- Repurpose and edit clips into fast-paced, high-retention vertical videos (under 60 seconds).

- Elevate edits with dynamic visual effects, sound effects, B-roll, engaging captions, and background music.

- Track current TikTok, Reels, and Shorts trends and weave them into our content strategy.

- Consistently hit daily/weekly qoutas of polished, ready-to-post clips.



What We're Looking For:

- Proven Experience: Solid background editing short-form content with a clear understanding of what drives views (strong hook, tight pacing, and retention techniques)

- Software Proficiency: Skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and/or DaVinci Resolve.

- Creative Instinct: Strong sense of comedic timing, visual storytelling, and audience engagement.

- WFH Ready: Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated work-from-home setup.



How to Apply:

If you think you’re the right fit for the Slimeatory team, send us a message containing the following:



1. Subject Line: Use "Slime Clipper: [Your Name]"

2. Quick Intro: Tell us briefly about yourself and your relevant short-form editing experience.

3. Portfolio (REQUIRED): Include a working link to your portfolio or Google Drive folder showcasing short-form clips you’ve edited (TikToks, Reels, or Shorts).



Please note: Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

title: AI Video Creator & Editor, Seedance 2.5 Short Film Series (3-minute episodes)
description:
Type of work: Full-time

Pay: $65 USD per finished episode(each episode just under 3 minutes)  (about 20 episodes a month, about $1,300/month), paid weekly for delivered episodes. Includes all generation credits and retries.

Hours: Flexible, paid on output. Must answer messages for 2–3 hours during U.S. Eastern evenings.



About us

JJ Creative Films makes cinematic AI thriller and drama films for
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Each film is about 10 episodes, and each episode runs under 3 minutes. We post one episode every Monday through Friday, so that's 2 films a month (about 20 episodes). Each film is also released as one full movie on YouTube when it ends.



What you'll do



 • Generate all footage in Seedance 2.5 at 480p, 16:9, using your own account. Credits and retries are included in your per-episode rate.

 • Work from what I provide: the script, character sheets, voice references, location references, and shot-by-shot prompts.

 • Keep continuity across every clip:

 • Same faces, wardrobe and voices.

 • Characters stay where they are.

 • Props stay in the right hands.

 • Each clip picks up from the last frame of the one before it.

 • Make sure every line comes from the right character, in the right voice, with clean lip sync. Regenerate anything that's wrong.

 • Edit each episode to 2:45–2:55, never over 2:58:

 • Keep the pacing tight, with 2–4 second shots in arguments.

 • Cut out every AI mistake.

 • Sound design: layer rain, room tone, doors, phones, and suspense effects (low drones, risers, heartbeats, booms). No music.

 • Keep one consistent color grade across every clip. Add text overlays when needed (phone screens). Put an end card on every episode.

 • Build one YouTube video each week combining that week's episodes, with chapters.

 • Build one full movie at the end of each film (all 10 episodes combined), about 2 a month.

 • Deliver each week's 5 episodes by Monday. Two rounds of revisions per episode are included.



Requirements



 • Proven Seedance experience. Show me finished pieces you generated yourself, ideally with dialogue scenes.

 • Strong at character and voice consistency across many clips.

 • Strong editor in CapCut (preferred) or Premiere Pro, with real sound design skills.

 • Good English, reliable internet, and a computer that can handle the work.

 • Can deliver 5 episodes every week, on deadline.



How to apply



 • Start your message with "WRONG GIRL" so I know you read the whole post.

 • Send 2–3 links to AI videos you generated and edited. Point out any with two or more people talking.

title: Remote Chat Sales Setter / Lead Engagement Specialist
description:
# Remote Chat Sales Setter / Lead Engagement Specialist



Elevated Recovery is hiring a highly organized, persuasive, and emotionally intelligent Chat Sales Setter to manage conversations with prospective clients across multiple platforms.



We help men overcome compulsive pornography use and related behaviors. This role requires maturity, discretion, empathy, and comfort discussing sensitive topics directly and professionally.



## What You’ll Do



* Manage multiple active conversations across SMS,
, social media, and our CRM

* Respond quickly while keeping every conversation personal and context-aware

* Ask thoughtful questions, identify needs, and guide qualified prospects toward booking a call

* Follow up consistently with new, old, and previously unresponsive leads

* Track large numbers of leads without losing conversations or missing next steps

* Keep CRM records, notes, statuses, and follow-up dates accurate

* Handle basic questions and objections through chat without sounding scripted

* Make outbound calls when necessary to reconnect with leads or confirm appointments

* Coordinate with the sales team to ensure clean handoffs and strong show rates



## You May Be a Strong Fit If You Are



* An excellent written communicator with natural, conversational English

* Experienced in chat sales, appointment setting, lead nurturing, or online sales

* Comfortable managing many conversations at once across different platforms

* Highly organized and attentive to small details

* Able to personalize templates rather than blindly copying and pasting them

* Persistent with follow-up without becoming pushy

* Comfortable making outbound calls when chat alone is not enough

* Coachable, adaptable, and able to implement feedback quickly

* Reliable during U.S. business hours and available for at least one weekend shift

* Comfortable discussing pornography, relationships, recovery, and other sensitive subjects professionally



## This Role Is Not a Fit If You



* Frequently miss messages or forget follow-ups

* Depend entirely on scripts and struggle to think within a live conversation

* Avoid phone calls

* Become overwhelmed when managing multiple platforms or a large lead pipeline

* Need constant supervision to keep CRM records organized

* Are uncomfortable discussing pornography and recovery directly



## Schedule and Compensation



* Full-time remote position

* Approximately 40 hours per week

* U.S. working hours, including at least one weekend day

* $5 USD per hour plus performance-based commissions

* Training, scripts, feedback, and ongoing sales development provided



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the words **“CHAT SETTER”** and include:



1. A brief description of your chat sales or appointment-setting experience.

2. The largest number of leads or active conversations you have managed.

3. The platforms and CRMs you have used.

4. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

5. A one- to two-minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be effective in this role.



Then answer this sample lead message in your own words:



> “I’m interested, but I’m not ready to book a call. Can you just tell me how much it costs?”



We are looking closely at your ability to write naturally, ask good questions, stay organized, and move a conversation forward.

, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Each film is about 10 episodes, and each episode runs under 3 minutes. We post one episode every Monday through Friday, so that's 2 films a month (about 20 episodes). Each film is also released as one full movie on YouTube when it ends. All footage is generated with Seedance 2.5.



What you'll do



 • Pitch film ideas, then write a full outline for each film (about 10 episodes, through the ending) before scripting.

 • Write about 2 complete films a month (5 episode scripts a week), each episode about 2:50 on screen.

 • Every episode needs:

 • A hook inside 3 seconds. The first line is the conflict. No walking in, no setup.

 • A turn every 15–20 seconds: a reveal, a lie exposed, a new problem.

 • Short, natural dialogue that sounds like real people. Interruptions, people talking over each other, no speeches.

 • One quiet emotional moment between the fights.

 • A cliffhanger ending that opens a new question and makes people need the next episode.

 • Write for AI production:

 • Small casts.

 • Clear physical actions.

 • Scenes that break into short, achievable shots.

 • No crowds or complicated stunts unless the story needs them.

 • Track continuity: who knows what, who has which prop, where everyone is, what time and day it is.

 • Revise quickly when footage or feedback calls for changes.

 • Deliver each week's 5 scripts at least one week ahead of posting, so production has time to generate and edit.



Requirements (must have)



 • Proven experience writing short-form serialized drama: micro-dramas, Reels or TikTok series, vertical drama apps, or YouTube story channels. Regular screenwriting, articles or ad copy alone isn't enough.

 • Links to episodes you wrote that were actually posted, ideally with view counts.

 • Strong English dialogue that sounds natural to American audiences.

 • Can deliver 5 scripts a week on deadline.

 • Big plus: experience writing shot-by-shot prompts for Seedance or other AI video tools.

 • Your rate per episode script (about 3 minutes on screen), and whether it includes the film outline.

title: Client Satisfaction Coordinator

About the Role



As our Client Satisfaction Coordinator, you will be the steady, friendly voice that checks in with our clients and families. You’ll make sure every new client’s onboarding was done right, gather honest feedback, and spot early signs that a client needs a schedule change or a follow-up visit from one of our Home Care Advisors. You’ll also help us celebrate our clients by tracking birthdays and special occasions.

Onboarding audit: Confirm each new client’s onboarding steps are finished, including:

The care plan is completed and on file

The client has been introduced to their caregiver(s) through caregiver bios

Any other onboarding checklist items

Satisfaction surveys: Run periodic client satisfaction surveys by phone,

Feedback escalation: Listen for and flag feedback that signals:

A scheduling need (more or fewer hours, a time change, a caregiver preference), which goes to our Scheduler

Any concern that needs management attention

Documentation: Log every contact, survey result and follow-up in our systems (WellSky, Airtable or similar) accurately and on time.

Qualifications

title: Health & Safety Specialist – New Zealand Experience Essential (Casual / Remote)
description:
MeasureUp Flooring Ltd is a New Zealand flooring and acoustic installation business. We are looking for an experienced Health and Safety specialist to support our team remotely on a casual, as-needed basis.



IMMEDIATE PROJECT — REVIEW OUR H&S SYSTEM AND SUPPORT SITEWISE GOLD

Your initial project is to review and strengthen our existing H&S arrangements and help complete our current SiteWise assessment/renewal, with Gold as the target. We need someone who can independently establish what is in place, identify gaps and set out a practical action plan with priorities, responsibilities and due dates.



Work with management and site staff to bring documents and records up to date, gather current evidence of actual work practices, address outstanding actions, prepare the assessment submission and assist with assessor feedback. After the initial project, provide casual ongoing support to keep records, training renewals, corrective actions and assessment evidence current throughout the year.



Practical NZ H&S and contractor prequalification or audit preparation experience is essential. SiteWise experience is preferred; equivalent experience with other assessment systems will be considered. Tell us which systems you have worked with, what you personally delivered, the results and how soon you can start.



PAY AND HOURS

US$11.00 per hour. Hours will vary according to workload, with no guaranteed weekly hours. Work must be agreed in advance. You will need some availability during New Zealand business hours to communicate with management and our site teams.



NEW ZEALAND EXPERIENCE IS ESSENTIAL

You must have practical experience supporting New Zealand businesses with health and safety, preferably in construction, trades or flooring. You must understand the Health and Safety at Work Act 2015, relevant regulations and current WorkSafe New Zealand guidance, and be able to apply them to real work situations.



YOUR WORK WILL INCLUDE

- Reviewing our existing H&S systems, identifying gaps and maintaining a clear action plan with named responsibilities and due dates.

- Preparing and updating site-specific safety plans, task risk assessments, JSAs, safe work procedures and toolbox talk material.

- Assisting with SiteWise assessments, renewals and contractor prequalification submissions, using genuine records and evidence supplied by our team.

- Maintaining hazard/risk registers, i
 and near-miss records, corrective actions, training records and expiry reminders.

- Maintaining safety data sheets and hazardous-substance information.

- Helping management address risks such as concrete grinding and dust, noise, adhesives and chemicals, manual handling, hot works and work in occupied buildings.

- Following up missing information and actions with staff, and keeping H&S documents organised in Google Drive and our digital systems.



This is a remote support role working alongside our New Zealand management and site teams. On-site checks and implementation will be coordinated with the people carrying out the work. You must clearly flag anything requiring site verification or specialist advice.



YOU MUST HAVE

- Demonstrable experience with New Zealand H&S requirements and the ability to work independently.

- Strong written and spoken English, accurate document preparation and reliable follow-through.

- The ability to turn requirements into clear, practical instructions for tradespeople.

- Confidence using Google Workspace and online H&S systems. SiteWise and SiteApp Pro experience will be an advantage; practical NZ H&S and comparable prequalification/audit preparation experience are essential.

- A reliable computer and internet connection.



TO APPLY

Use “NZ SAFETY” in your application subject and include:

1. Your CV and relevant H&S qualifications.

2. Specific details of your experience supporting NZ businesses: industry, your responsibilities and how recently you did this work.

3. Your experience with SiteWise or comparable contractor prequalification/audit systems, including work you personally completed, results achieved and an example of improving an existing H&S system.

4. One redacted example of relevant work, if you are authorised to share it. Remove client names, personal information and confidential details.

5. How soon you can start, your availability during NZ business hours and confirmation that you accept US$11.00 per hour on an as-needed basis.



Please apply only if you already have the relevant New Zealand H&S knowledge and experience.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Company Overview

An outsourced accounting and fractional CFO firm serving tech startups, service businesses, and venture-backed companies across the US. The business runs alongside a separate US entity following an acquisition, and is actively hiring on both sides. Strong US go-to-market motion, small senior team, fast pace.



Role Summary

You are the managing partner’s right hand for inbox, calendar, and keeping deals moving. This is not a passive scheduling job. You are expected to see conflicts before they happen, know who is contacting him and why, and bring solutions rather than questions.

1. The single most important thing in this role is the priority order:

2. Prospects first. Someone new reaching out is the highest priority in the business. They get booked fast.

Clients second. Existing clients come next.

3. Partnership conversations third. Valuable, but they move when something above them needs the slot.

Everything you prioritize, reschedule, or escalate follows that order. If you cannot tell which bucket something falls in, you find out.



Proactive Calendar Ownership

Read the calendar at least two weeks ahead, every week. Conflicts get caught in advance, not the night before.

Never cancel or move a meeting without checking first, including on holidays. Ask about an upcoming holiday a week out, not the morning of.

New prospect and new client meetings get booked into the soonest workable slot. People reaching out for the first time do not wait.

Build and maintain color-coding by meeting type, so priority is visible at a glance and you know what can move.

Protect focus blocks, handle buffers and travel, manage timezones across entities.

Own reschedules end to end.



Know Who’s Who

Learn the clients, prospects, partners, and team. This is a short list and it is learnable.

When an unfamiliar name appears, find out before you act: check the
 domain, check the CRM, look up the company. Ask the GTM lead or the team if it is still unclear.

“I didn’t know who it was” is not a reason to deprioritize something.

Build and keep a reference of key contacts, their category, and how they should be handled.



Inbox Ownership

Daily triage across multiple inboxes in Front. Filter FYIs, newsletters, and noise into holding areas.

Keep “Assigned to Me” limited to what genuinely needs the managing partner.

Draft replies in his voice using prior threads and templates.

Maintain clear states: Needs response, Awaiting reply, FYI, Later, Delegated.

Coordinate with teammates who tag and assign in Front so nothing stalls.



CRM and Deal Support (Pipedrive)

Your lane is clear: get the lead and the scheduled meeting into Pipedrive. The GTM lead manages the deal from there. No finger-pointing, no gaps.

Make sure follow-ups happen on time and nothing drops.

Create reminders and nudges for next steps and scheduling.

Help close the gap between AI meeting notes and the CRM so call context lands where the team can use it.



Systems Improvement (Weekly, Ongoing)

This is a standing part of the job, not an onboarding project. Every week you bring at least one concrete improvement to how the account runs. Not a list of suggestions, a change you have thought through and are ready to implement.

Every improvement is judged against two goals:

Smoother operations. Less friction in the week, and less of the managing partner’s time spent on coordination.

Easier sales flow. Prospects get booked faster, follow-ups don’t drop, and deals move without anyone chasing.



In practice:

Calendar color-coding by meeting type. This is the first one.

Message tagging so urgency is unambiguous: FYI, FNS (for next shift), URGENT.

Closing the gap between AI meeting notes and the CRM.

Templates for recurring
 types, scheduling links for common meeting types, a maintained contact reference.

Removing a step from anything you find yourself doing manually more than twice.



Document what you change. If you cannot say in one sentence which of the two goals an improvement serves, it is not the right one that week.



Working With the Internal Operations Hire

The company is adding a US-based operations person who will carry more day-to-day client and prospect detail. You are the executive-side owner: inbox, calendar, scheduling, routing, and follow-up discipline. They are the client-detail owner. You are expected to build a working rhythm with them quickly and define the handoffs rather than wait to be told.



Communication

Text is the primary channel with the managing partner. Be responsive and concise.

Use message tagging so urgency is obvious: FYI, FNS, URGENT / ACTION NEEDED.

Short daily status: what changed, what needs attention, what is blocked.

Flag problems early. Surprises are worse than bad news.



Tools

Front (primary inbox and calendar hub), Google Workspace and Microsoft, Pipedrive, Calendly, Reclaim, Slack, PandaDoc, QuickBooks (awareness only), AI drafting and notetaking tools.

description:
Daily Delegates is hiring a creative, organized Virtual Assistant to help manage GTA gaming content for YouTube and social media. The right person can spot strong moments in gameplay, turn them into engaging clips and videos, and keep a consistent posting schedule.



This role combines video editing, content research, channel support, and performance tracking. You should enjoy gaming content and know how to make viewers want to keep watching.



Responsibilities

Review client-provided gameplay, stream recordings, and other approved footage to find strong moments.

Use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to help review transcripts, identify potential clips, and draft content ideas. Watch and verify every selected moment yourself.

Edit vertical clips for YouTube Shorts and approved social platforms.

Help create longer YouTube videos with a clear story, commentary, or breakdown.

Write and refine titles, descriptions, captions, and thumbnail concepts using relevant search terms.

Schedule and publish client-approved content on YouTube and agreed social accounts.

Keep a content calendar and tracker updated with drafts, approvals, publish dates, links, and results.

Review channel analytics, including watch time, retention, views, and subscriber activity, and use the findings to suggest future content tests.

Send regular updates and a weekly performance recap to the client.

Keep footage, account access, and client information secure.

Important Content Standards

Use client-owned or properly approved footage. Track creator permission, credit requirements, platform limits, and other usage terms before editing or posting.

Add original commentary, storytelling, analysis, or other meaningful creative value to edits.

Get written client approval for each post before it goes live.

Do not download or repost another creator’s content without documented permission.

Qualifications

Experience editing YouTube Shorts, TikToks, Reels, or gaming videos.

Comfortable using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software.

Familiar with YouTube Studio, scheduling posts, and basic channel analytics.

Strong written English and a good sense of hooks, pacing, captions, and titles.

Organized, dependable, responsive, and able to meet deadlines.

Comfortable using AI tools to support research and drafting, while checking their work for accuracy.

Reliable internet connection and a computer capable of editing video.

GTA or gaming-content experience is preferred.

Schedule and Compensation

Part-time: approximately 20 hours per week

Full-time: approximately 40 hours per week

Starting compensation: $4 per hour, with potential increases based on performance, reliability, and client feedback.

Schedule and assigned hours will be discussed during hiring.

How to Apply

A short introduction and a brief description of your experience with gaming or YouTube content.

Links to 2–3 video edits you created, preferably Shorts or gaming clips.

The editing software and AI tools you use.

Your internet speed and computer specifications.

Your available work schedule and whether you prefer part-time or full-time.

A short video introduction explaining why you’re a good fit.

Applications without editing samples and a video introduction may not be considered.

title: Talent Coordinator | Influencer Marketing & Brand Partnerships
description:
Talent Coordinator | Influencer Marketing & Brand Partnerships



Company: Lucious Management

Website: 

Location: Remote — Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time Freelance / Independent Contractor

Monthly Compensation: $200–$250 USD + Performance-Based Commission

Working Schedule: Monday–Friday, 1:00 PM–9:00 PM Eastern Time (New York, USA)

Hours: 40 hours per week

Payment Method: Wise (Preferred) 



⸻



About Lucious Management



Lucious management is a growing talent management agency specializing in beauty, fashion, and lifestyle content creators and influencers.



We represent digital creators and help them secure paid brand partnerships, build professional relationships with brands, and develop long-term opportunities within the influencer marketing industry.



Our agency operates through its official online presence at 
, with our team handling day-to-day brand and partnership correspondence through our Lucious Talent business
, accessible at partnerships AT 



We are currently expanding our team and looking for a second reliable, detail-oriented, and proactive Talent Coordinator to work alongside our existing Talent Coordinator, AJ.



This is an opportunity to join a growing agency, work directly with an established talent coordination team, and contribute to the development and commercial success of our creator roster.



Position Overview



The Talent Coordinator will support the agency’s daily operations, primarily focusing on brand outreach, pitching, follow-ups, campaign coordination, and administrative organization.



You will work collaboratively with our existing Talent Coordinator, AJ, and report to the Founder & Head of Talent.



We are looking for someone who can manage assigned responsibilities independently, communicate effectively with international brands, and maintain consistent productivity throughout their scheduled working hours.



This position requires someone who takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions for every individual task.



Key Responsibilities



1. Brand Outreach & Partnership Pitching



* Research and identify brands that align with our creators’ niches, audiences, aesthetics, and interests.

* Pitch creators to beauty, skincare, cosmetics, fashion, clothing, accessories, footwear, lifestyle, and other relevant brands.

* Contact brand representatives, influencer marketing managers, PR agencies, and partnership departments.

* Prepare and send professional, personalized brand outreach
s.

* Conduct follow-ups with brands according to assigned outreach schedules.

* Maintain accurate records of all pitches, responses, and potential opportunities.

* Identify opportunities for paid collaborations, events, PR campaigns, gifting, and other relevant partnerships.

* Prioritize paid collaborations while identifying worthwhile opportunities for our creators.



2.
 & Inbox Management



* Organize creator-specific
 accounts.

* Maintain appropriate
 labels and folders.

* Categorize brand responses, partnership inquiries, affiliate opportunities, invoices, contracts, and campaign correspondence.

* Monitor incoming
s and promptly identify important brand responses.

* Keep inboxes organized and ensure no important partnership opportunities are overlooked.

* Maintain monthly pitching and outreach organization.



3. Campaign & Partnership Coordination



* Track ongoing brand campaigns and partnership deadlines.

* Assist with campaign scheduling and creator calendars.

* Monitor deliverables, posting deadlines, campaign requirements, and follow-up obligations.

* Request campaign briefs, budgets, timelines, and licensing information from brands when necessary.

* Communicate important campaign updates to the Founder & Head of Talent.

* Assist with coordinating creators, editors, and approved vendors.



4. Contract Review & Administrative Support



* Review draft campaign agreements and identify unusual or unfavorable terms.

* Prepare suggested edits and redlines based on agency instructions.

* Flag concerns involving usage rights, licensing, exclusivity, paid advertising, whitelisting, Spark Ads, raw footage, deliverables, and payment terms.

* Organize signed agreements and relevant campaign documentation.

* Assist with maintaining agency records and internal databases.



Important: This position does not have independent authority to accept brand deals, sign contracts, approve final campaign terms, or independently negotiate rates without written authorization.



All final deal approvals and creator representation decisions remain with the Founder & Head of Talent.



5. Team Coordination



* Work directly with the existing Talent Coordinator, AJ.

* Coordinate assigned responsibilities and avoid duplicating outreach.

* Communicate progress, outstanding assignments, and important updates.

* Participate in internal coordination and follow established agency procedures.

* Maintain organized handovers when assignments require collaboration.



Daily Work Schedule & Expectations



The required schedule is:



Monday through Friday



* Start: 1:00 PM Eastern Time (New York, USA).

* End: 9:00 PM Eastern Time (New York, USA).

* Weekly schedule: 40 hours.



Applicants must be able to consistently work according to New York’s Eastern Time, including daylight-saving-time changes.



This is not a flexible-hours position. Applicants must be available during the specified schedule.



Coordinators are expected to complete their assigned daily responsibilities, maintain accurate records, and communicate any outstanding work before the end of their shift.



Assignments must not simply be abandoned or left without an update when the scheduled shift ends. If an urgent task requires additional time, the coordinator must communicate with management and obtain approval for any additional working hours. Any additional work and compensation will be handled in accordance with the agreed arrangement and applicable law.



Performance Expectations & Pitching Standards



We value quality, consistency, and actual results over simply sending large quantities of
s.



Our general outreach planning range is approximately 100–150 targeted opportunities per assigned creator per month, depending on the roster, workload, creator preferences, and available opportunities.



The maximum general planning limit is 200 opportunities per creator per month unless otherwise approved.



We expect:



* Professional and personalized outreach.

* Accurate spelling, grammar, and creator information.

* Appropriate brand and creator matching.

* Consistent follow-ups.

* Proper tracking of outreach.

* Timely responses to brand inquiries.

* Initiative in identifying new partnership opportunities.

* No fabricated analytics, rates, or creator information.



AI Policy



We do not permit AI-generated or AI-assisted brand pitching or outreach.



Every pitch must be individually written, thoughtfully personalized, and reviewed by the coordinator before sending. We want genuine human communication, not generic automated messages.



Compensation & Commission Structure



Monthly Compensation: $200–$250 USD



The final monthly rate will depend on qualifications, relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated performance, and overall suitability for the position.



Compensation is performance-oriented.



We expect coordinators to consistently complete their responsibilities and demonstrate meaningful contributions to the agency’s pitching and partnership efforts.



Performance reviews may consider:



* Quality and quantity of targeted pitches.

* Successful brand responses and conversions.

* Paid partnerships directly generated through the coordinator’s outreach.

* Consistency of follow-ups.

* Organization and reliability.

* Overall contribution to creator growth and agency operations.



Where performance consistently falls below reasonable expectations, compensation may be reviewed prospectively, with any agreed adjustment documented in writing and subject to applicable law. Earned compensation will not be retroactively reduced.



Additional 5% Commission



Coordinators are eligible to receive an additional 5% of the actual agency commission received from qualifying brand deals they personally source through their original pitches and meaningful follow-up.



For clarity, this is NOT 5% of the creator’s gross campaign payment.



Example:



* Creator’s brand deal: $2,000.

* Agency commission (20%): $400.

* Coordinator’s commission (5% of agency commission): $20.



The bonus is only applicable when the coordinator’s original pitch directly results in a qualifying paid partnership, the creator accepts the opportunity, management approves it, and the agency actually receives its commission.



Gifted-only collaborations, unpaid opportunities, canceled deals, and previously active opportunities do not qualify.



Payment Methods



Our preferred payment method is Wise, as it allows us to maintain organized international payment records and documentation.



We can also accommodate:



* GCash.

* Another mutually agreed payment method in exceptional circumstances.



All payments are denominated in USD, with the agreed receiving method and applicable transaction fees discussed before payment.



Professional Requirements & Confidentiality



Because this position involves access to creator accounts, brand contacts, private campaign information, and agency operations, confidentiality is essential.



The successful applicant must:



* Protect all agency and creator information.

* Never share account credentials or grant unauthorized access.

* Never use creator information or brand contacts for personal business or another agency.

* Never solicit our represented creators for independent representation.

* Never bypass management or redirect agency opportunities.

* Disclose potential conflicts of interest involving other talent agencies or influencer management businesses.

* Follow agency communication and account-security procedures.

* Maintain professional communication with brands, creators, and team members.



This is a non-exclusive freelance opportunity, subject to disclosure of potential conflicts and confidentiality requirements.



Qualifications



Our ideal applicant should have:



1. Excellent written and spoken English.

2. Strong professional
 communication skills.

3. Experience in influencer marketing, virtual assistance, talent coordination, PR, brand outreach, or digital marketing.

4. Familiarity with Gmail and Google Workspace.

5. Strong organizational and time-management skills.

6. Ability to research brands and identify relevant partnership contacts.

7. Attention to detail, particularly with names, deliverables, rates, and campaign information.

8. Ability to work independently and collaborate with another coordinator.

9. Reliable internet connection and a suitable computer.

10. Ability to work consistently during the required Eastern Time schedule.



Experience working with influencers, content creators, talent agencies, or brand partnership campaigns is strongly preferred.



Interview & Selection Process



Our current Talent Coordinator, AJ, will participate in the interview and evaluation process.



The selection process may include:



* An initial application review.

* An interview with AJ.

* An assessment of written English and professional communication.

* A practical brand research and pitching exercise.

* An evaluation of organizational skills and attention to detail.

* A final interview or approval by the Founder & Head of Talent.



We are specifically looking for someone who can work well with our existing coordinator and contribute to a collaborative, organized team.



Trial Period & Engagement



The selected applicant will be subject to a 30-day paid trial period.



During this period, we will evaluate reliability, communication, pitching quality, productivity, attention to detail, confidentiality, and overall compatibility with our team.



Continued engagement will be governed by the Talent Coordinator Agreement provided to the successful applicant.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your full name and current location in the Philippines.

2. Your relevant work experience.

3. Any previous experience with influencer marketing, brand pitching, PR, or talent coordination.

4. Your familiarity with Gmail, Google Workspace, and campaign management.

5. Confirmation that you can work Monday–Friday, 1:00 PM–9:00 PM Eastern Time.

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the $200–$250 USD monthly compensation range and performance-based commission structure.

7. Your preferred payment method (Wise or GCash).

8. A short explanation of why you believe you would be a good fit for Lucious Talent.



Please include the phrase “LUCIOUS TALENT COORDINATOR” in your application so we know you have carefully read the entire job posting.



We are looking for someone dependable, ambitious, detail-oriented, and interested in growing alongside an expanding talent management agency.



We look forward to meeting you!

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 12:00 or 1:00 PM until 6:00 or 7:00 PM Mountain Time (about 3:00/4:00 AM – 9:00/10:00 AM Philippine Time; one hour earlier in Philippine Time during US daylight saving time)

Compensation: USD TBD per month + performance bonus per contracted agent

Fluent, professional English (spoken and written) is required. You will speak directly by phone and video with licensed insurance agents in the United States every day. Applicants without strong conversational English will not be considered.

About Us

Sloan Healthcare Innovations is a US healthcare growth and distribution firm. We partner with insurance brokers, general agents, FMOs, associations, and TPAs to bring innovative health benefit solutions to market. We are growing our network of independent licensed life and health insurance agents across the United States, and we need an experienced recruiter and trainer to help us build that team.

The Role

You will recruit, onboard, and train licensed life and health insurance agents in the United States. You will manage the full recruiting pipeline — from first outreach to a signed, contracted, and appointed agent — and then lead virtual training so new agents understand our insurance products and can use our enrollment platforms with confidence. This is a phone- and video-heavy role for someone who already knows the US insurance agent world and the American health insurance market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Source agents — Build prospect lists of licensed life and health agents using LinkedIn, state licensing lookups,
 groups, industry directories, and other tools.

2. Outbound outreach — Make cold calls and send
s, texts, and LinkedIn messages to introduce our opportunity. Target: 8-10 meaningful conversations per day.

3. Qualify candidates — Confirm active state licenses, lines of authority, production history, carrier appointments, and fit with our products and markets.

4. Book appointments — Schedule qualified agents for discovery and onboarding calls with US leadership.

5. Follow up consistently — Run multi-touch follow-up sequences so no lead goes cold.

6. Support contracting and onboarding — Guide new agents through contracting paperwork, E&O and license verification, and carrier appointments.

7. Deliver virtual training — Lead live Zoom/Teams training sessions for new and existing agents on our insurance products: plan design, eligibility, benefits, pricing, and how to position them with clients.

8. Train on our enrollment platforms — Become an expert user of the quoting and enrollment platforms we use, and teach agents how to quote, enroll members, and troubleshoot common issues.

9. Build training materials — Create and maintain simple guides, checklists, FAQs, and recorded walk-throughs.

10. Manage the CRM — Log every call,
, training, and status change; keep pipeline data clean.

11. Report weekly — Calls made, conversations, appointments set, agents contracted, trainings delivered, and pipeline status.

Required Qualifications

• Fluent English — clear, confident, natural speaking voice with a neutral accent; excellent written English with correct grammar.

• Insurance license — an active US state Life & Health (A
 & Health) producer license is strongly preferred. At minimum, a current Philippine Insurance Commission life/health license or completed US pre-licensing coursework.

title: Business Development & Research Assistant
description:
About ZMH Group

ZMH Group is developing relationships with organisations involved in social housing, supported living, temporary accommodation and emergency accommodation. The business wants to understand organisations’ accommodation requirements so the Director can assess potential property opportunities and partnerships.



Purpose of the role

Research relevant providers and councils, identify decision-makers, make professional introductory contact, understand and record accommodation requirements, complete follow-ups, arrange introductory appointments and maintain accurate company records.



Key responsibilities

Provider research

Identify social housing providers, supported living operators and temporary/emergency accommodation organisations. Review each organisation’s website and services before contact. Prioritise organisations whose work aligns with temporary, emergency or supported accommodation.

Council research

Identify local authorities and relevant housing, temporary accommodation, procurement, commissioning and supplier teams. Find appropriate public contact routes and procurement portals.



Outreach

Make approved introductory calls and send approved
s. Personalise contact based on research, identify the right person and ask how ZMH Group may be of value.



Requirements gathering

Record operating areas, expansion areas, property types and bedroom sizes, property condition/standards, HMO licensing requirements and rent/payment settings.

Follow-ups and appointments

Complete agreed follow-ups, record outcomes and next actions, and arrange introductory meetings for the Director.

Google Sheets, Excel Sheets and reporting

Maintain provider and council trackers, log outreach, complete a daily work log and submit a short Loom end-of-day summary.

Inbox management

Monitor the designated inbox, organise correspondence, use approved routine templates and escalate opportunities or sensitive matters.



Scope boundaries

This role is limited to providers and councils. The VA must NOT research or contact landlords, private property owners or sellers, and must NOT source properties. These activities remain with the Director unless changed by written instruction.

The VA must not promise property availability, quote or agree rents, negotiate commercial terms, confirm licensing/compliance, submit tenders, make financial commitments or sign agreements. Refer these matters to the Director.



Candidate requirements

• Excellent spoken and written English and a confident telephone manner.

• Experience in B2B research, lead generation, appointment setting or customer support.

• Confident using Google Sheets, Excel,
 and online research tools.

• Able to research organisations and identify appropriate decision-makers.

• Accurate, organised, proactive and comfortable working independently.

• Willing to maintain a daily activity log and record short Loom updates.



Working pattern and assessment

The role is 20 - 25  hours per week, normally five hours per day Monday to Friday. Agree the exact working window with the Director to provide useful overlap with UK business hours. Review performance weekly, with a 30-day assessment and any probation period set out in the written agreement.

Recruitment exercise



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to research a small sample of relevant UK providers and councils, identify the correct contact route, complete a sample requirements record and record a short Loom walkthrough.

title: Phone Setter for a Luxury US Travel Club, Neutral American Accent Only
description:
If you've spent years on a BPO floor reading a script to people who hang up on you, this job is different.



Mercury is a members-only travel club in the US. Our members fly business and first class and stay at the best hotels in the world. Every day, wealthy Americans fill in a form asking to join, and they expect a call fast. Making that call is the job.



This role is only for people with a very light accent or no accent at all. Our members are wealthy Americans, and the first voice they hear from us has to sound natural to them. If people often ask you to repeat yourself, or can tell right away where you're from, this isn't the job for you.



What you'll do each day:

- A new application comes in. You call within 60 seconds.

- You ask how they travel, then let them talk. No hard pitch.

- When someone is a fit, you bring our founder onto the call live or book them on his calendar.

- You text and follow up with anyone who doesn't pick up, and win back the ones who miss their call.

- You keep every lead's notes and stage up to date in GoHighLevel.



Every person you call asked to hear from us. You won't be cold calling.



Why it's worth applying:

- $1,000 USD a month, paid monthly.

- One company and one founder who answers your questions. You're not one seat on a floor of hundreds.

- You'll talk to some of the most well-traveled people in the world and learn how luxury sales works from the inside.

- You start with a paid trial week, so we both know it fits before you commit.



You're right for this if:

- You've done inbound calling or appointment setting for a US company, and you can tell us your numbers.

- You have a very light accent or none. Americans never ask you to repeat yourself, and you sound calm, warm and unhurried on the phone.

- You've looked after premium customers before, like an airline premium desk, a luxury hotel, card concierge, real estate or high ticket sales.

title: CALL CENTER MANAGER
description:
Remote Call Center Manager – Outbound Appointment Setting | 20-Setter Team

Sierra Roof Inc. | Philippines-based | Full-time, remote

Schedule Sunday through Friday, California Pacific Time. Saturday off on the California schedule. Applicants must be available for the corresponding overnight hours in the Philippines.

Compensation $10–$15 USD per hour, depending on experience, plus weekly and monthly performance bonuses and commission opportunities.



Sierra Roof  is an Anaheim, California roofing and exterior remodeling company. Our appointment setters book in-home estimates for our field sales team. We’re hiring a hands-on manager who can recruit, lead, and hold a remote team of 20 appointment setters accountable for the appointments our sales representatives actually run.



Apply only if you have at least five years of call center management experience and have personally managed a remote outbound appointment-setting team of at least 20 setters. You must have owned the team’s quotas, reviewed individual calls, made hiring and performance decisions, and managed appointment confirmations. In your application, we’ll ask for the size of your team, the numbers you owned, and an example of a result you improved.

What you’ll own

Recruit, hire, and train the team. Maintain a pipeline of qualified setters. Interview candidates, run live phone auditions, and make hiring decisions. Train new hires on homeowner conversations, objections, GoHighLevel, dialer use, and booking standards. Listen to their first calls and track how quickly they reach quota. When a setter consistently misses expectations, deliver direct feedback, set a measurable improvement deadline, and replace them when necessary.



Lead a morning huddle every shift. Come prepared with yesterday’s results, today’s open sales slots, and each setter’s target. Recognize strong calls, coach one specific skill, and make sure every setter starts the shift knowing which leads to work and what they’re expected to produce. Check performance again mid-shift while there is still time to correct it.



Manage every setter’s production. Review attendance, dialer activity, live contacts, appointments booked, confirmations, and appointments held. Listen to recordings from every setter each week. If someone is making calls but booking few appointments, identify where the conversation breaks down, role-play the correction, and review subsequent calls to see whether it worked. Be ready to take a live call and demonstrate the standard yourself.



Own appointment confirmation and dispatch. Every appointment must be confirmed with the homeowner before a sales rep is dispatched. Build a confirmation process with a named owner, a deadline, and a recorded outcome for every booking. Verify the date, time, property address, and purpose of the visit. A sent text or an unanswered call stays pending until the homeowner responds. Prioritize same-day appointments, flag at-risk slots early, and coordinate reschedules and replacements with sales. Our target is a 75% or higher show rate.



Control lead flow throughout the day. Monitor new inquiries and hold the team to a one-to-five-minute first-contact attempt during staffed hours. Assign callbacks, monitor overdue follow-ups, and recycle older leads into the appropriate campaigns. Keep GoHighLevel, LeadPerfection, and the sales calendar accurate so another team member can open a record and know exactly what happened and what comes next.



Report results and act on them. Send a concise end-of-day scorecard showing each setter’s goal and actual production, plus team totals for leads received, contacts, bookings, confirmations, held appointments, cancellations, and no-shows. When performance falls short, explain where the drop occurred, what you changed, and what you’ll check the next day.

Required experience

- At least five years managing call center operations, with direct responsibility for a remote outbound team of 20 or more appointment setters.

- Hands-on GoHighLevel experience managing pipelines, lead assignments, tasks, dispositions, and reporting.

- Hands-on experience with WAVV, multi-line dialers, LeadPerfection, and RingCentral. You must be able to operate the systems yourself and coach setters through them.

- Direct ownership of an appointment confirmation process, including same-day confirmations, reschedules, no-show recovery, and coordination with field sales.

- Experience recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, coaching, and replacing setters.

- Clear spoken and written English, reliable internet, a backup connection, and a quiet workspace suitable for live calls and coaching.

Experience booking U.S. residential roofing, solar, or home improvement appointments is strongly preferred.

How to apply

Use the subject line Call Center Manager | [Largest Setter Team You Managed] Setters | [Your Name]. Attach your résumé and answer the following four questions. Use actual figures where available and leave out confidential employer or customer information.

1. What was the largest remote appointment-setting team you personally managed? Give the number of active setters, how many reported directly to you, how long you led them, what they booked, and which hiring and performance decisions you owned.

2. What did your team produce in a typical week? Give the per-setter quota and the team’s booked, confirmed, and held appointment counts for the same period. Explain how you calculated show rate and describe one result you improved.

3. How did you use GoHighLevel, WAVV, LeadPerfection, and RingCentral? For each system, name one task you personally performed as the manager.

4. How would you handle this shift? It’s 8:30 a.m. California time. Four of today’s ten appointments are still unconfirmed, two setters called out, and fresh leads are arriving. Walk us through your first 30 minutes. Tell us what you handle personally, what you delegate, and when you update the sales team.

Include a 90–120 second Loom video describing one underperforming setter you managed. Tell us what you heard on their calls, what you coached, and what happened afterward. Finish by confirming your availability for the Sunday–Friday California schedule.



Shortlisted candidates will lead a five-minute mock morning huddle and coach a sample appointment-setting call. We want to hear how you set expectations, spot a missed opportunity, and show a setter what to say on the next call.

I’m Shloimy, bandleader and founder of Zaltz Band. We perform popular Jewish music at weddings, and I’m looking for a talented orchestrator and arranger to build an ongoing working relationship with.



I’m looking for someone who can take a melody and turn it into a beautiful, emotional arrangement—with thoughtful chords, expressive orchestration, and a strong sense of rhythm and groove.



What you’ll do



* Create arrangements for a live band, including strings, horns, and rhythm section.

* Write clear, accurate drum notation and individual instrumental parts.

* Prepare polished scores and practical, easy-to-read parts for live performance.

* Learn my workflow, follow musical direction, and incorporate feedback.

* Study Jewish wedding music to understand its styles, phrasing, energy, and feel.



What I’m looking for



* Strong proficiency in Sibelius is essential. Dorico experience is a bonus.

* Excellent knowledge of harmony, chord voicings, and orchestration.

* Experience writing for strings and horns, with an understanding of each instrument’s range and capabilities.

* Strong rhythmic skills and the ability to write accurately for a rhythm section.

* Musical sensitivity: knowing when to add detail and when to leave space.

* Fast turnaround, careful attention to detail, and reliable communication.

* An open attitude toward learning, adapting, and developing a feel for our music.



Prior experience with Jewish music is welcome, but not required. A willingness to listen closely, study the style, and keep improving is essential.



How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction describing your arranging and orchestration experience.

2. Two or three examples of your work, ideally with both audio and PDF scores or individual parts. Please explain your contribution to each.

3. Your experience with Sibelius, including drum notation and preparing instrumental parts.

4. Your availability, typical turnaround time, and hourly or project rates.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small paid arranging trial to see how we work together.

title: Instagram DM Appointment Setter for a Music Label (Part Time, Evenings US Time)
description:
We are 0102, an independent music label and artist development company based in Montreal, Canada. We help independent artists release their music properly: release planning, marketing and distribution, while the artist keeps their masters.



We are hiring one Instagram appointment setter. Your job is to start conversations with independent artists on Instagram, keep those conversations going, and book a short call between the artist and one of our A&Rs. You do not sell and you do not talk about prices. You book calls.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Send short, personal first messages to independent artists (you comment on a real song of theirs and ask one question)

- Reply to artists who answer, quickly and naturally

- Follow up with artists who went quiet, always with a question

- When an artist agrees to talk, offer two times and book the call yourself in our calendar

- Leave a short 3-line note for the A&R before each call (the song, what the artist wants, anything important they said)

- Work from a daily list that tells you who is waiting on a reply, who to follow up with, and how many new artists to message



WHAT YOU WILL NEVER DO

- Quote prices or negotiate

- Promise streams, playlists, followers or any result

- Pretend to be someone else. You write as yourself, part of the 0102 A&R team



HOURS

- 4 hours a day, 6 days a week (24 hours a week)

- Your shift is your morning in the Philippines, roughly 8am to 12pm PHT (7pm to 11pm Eastern Time). This is when artists in North America are active, and fast replies matter a lot in this job.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Excellent written English. Casual, natural, not robotic. This is the most important skill.

- You know Instagram very well and ideally you listen to hip hop, R&B, pop or Afro music

- Appointment setting, DM setting or chat sales experience is a plus, not required

- Reliable internet and a phone or laptop you can use every day

- You follow a process and a script, and you also know when a conversation needs a human answer



PAY

- Hourly base pay (see wage below)

- Bonuses available

- Paid 3-day trial before we decide on long term



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "SETTER" so we know you read this post. Then write your reply, as you would send it in an Instagram DM, to these 3 situations (purpose is to set the call for a service closer):



1. You messaged an artist about their new song. They answer: "Thanks! What is this about?"

2. An artist says: "Is this paid? How much does it cost?"

3. An artist says: "I have been burned by promo companies many times before."



Applications without the 3 replies will not be reviewed.

title: Full-Time Remote Operations Coordinator l Philippines-Based | Long-Term | Growth Opportunity
description:
# Full-Time Remote Operations Coordinator  

### Philippines-Based | Long-Term | Growth Opportunity



**Site Masters Junk Removal** is a fast-growing Tampa Bay junk removal and property cleanup company. We are hiring a long-term **Remote Operations Coordinator** to help keep our customers, technicians, trucks, schedules, estimates, invoices, and job documentation organized.



This is not a basic data-entry role. You will help operate the remote control tower of a growing field-service business.



We value people who are organized, proactive, calm under pressure, honest, and willing to take ownership.



## Main Responsibilities



### Operations and Scheduling



- Build and update daily technician routes.

- Confirm job addresses, timing, crew assignments, and special instructions.

- Communicate route information to technicians.

- Monitor delays, schedule changes, callouts, and vehicle issues.

- Coordinate with the field operations manager regarding truck, equipment, and safety issues.

- Keep Jobber and internal records accurate.

- Track open issues until they have an owner and next action.



### Customer Communication



- Answer customer messages and provide professional updates.

- Communicate ETAs, delays, reschedules, and missing information.

- Request photos for remote estimates.

- Follow up with customers when details are incomplete.

- Document customer conversations and commitments.

- Escalate complaints, property damage, payment issues, and unusual requests.



### Estimates, Invoices, and Follow-Up



- Prepare draft estimates using approved pricing procedures.

- Prepare and send invoices.

- Follow up on open quotes and unpaid invoices.

- Request deposits or payments when required.

- Review job details before customer-facing documents are sent.

- Escalate pricing questions or unusual discounts for approval.

- Call technicians to communicate timelines and changes and ensure on-time delivery (you will be using the phone in this role)



### Job Documentation and Quality Control



- Review before-and-after photos.

- Organize customer photo albums and Google Drive folders.

- Request missing or unclear job documentation.

- Confirm notes, photos, payments, and invoices are completed.

- Track incomplete jobs until they are properly closed.



### Phone Support



You may also answer company phone lines as backup support. Depending on your experience and performance, phone responsibilities may become a larger part of the role.



Phone responsibilities may include:



- Answering inbound customer calls.

- Qualifying leads.

- Booking appointments.

- Gathering job details and photos.

- Handling basic pricing questions using approved guidelines.

- Documenting calls accurately.

- Escalating sales, safety, and customer-service issues.



## Requirements



- Previous virtual assistant experience is required.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to work Monday through Saturday, approximately **8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time**.

- Minimum typing speed of **50 WPM**.

- Reliable computer capable of handling multiple browser tabs and software systems.

- **At least 8GB RAM, SSD storage, and a second monitor available from the start.**

- Reliable primary internet connection.

- Backup internet or mobile data.

- Quiet workspace and reliable headset for phone support.

- Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

- Comfortable learning software quickly.

- Able to stay calm while handling multiple urgent issues.

- Willing to receive direct feedback and improve.



Experience with Jobber, Google Workspace, Google Sheets, CRMs, dispatch, customer service, logistics, or home-service businesses is preferred.



## Compensation



- **$1,200 to $1,500 USD per month to start**, depending on experience and performance.

- Paid trial period.

- Compensation can increase as you demonstrate independent ownership, accuracy, phone ability, and reduced need for supervision.

- Strong performers can grow into senior operations or team-lead responsibility.



This is a long-term opportunity. We are building a serious remote operations team, not looking for someone to complete random short-term tasks.



## Core Values



### Unshakable Integrity



Tell the truth, communicate early, follow through, and own mistakes.



### Extreme Ownership



Do not simply forward problems. Identify the next action, assign ownership, and follow up until the issue is resolved.



### Relentlessly Driven



Learn quickly, improve constantly, and perform at a high level without needing to be chased.



### Calm Under Pressure



Operations create problems every day. We solve them clearly, professionally, and without spreading confusion.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your résumé.

2. A short introduction explaining your VA experience.

3. Your current typing speed.

4. Your computer specifications.

5. Confirmation that you have a second monitor.

6. Your internet and backup-internet setup.

7. Your available working hours in Eastern Time.

8. Your expected monthly compensation.

9. The word **Precision** in the subject line or first line of your application.



Qualified applicants will receive a separate screening application and next-step instructions.



All application communication will happen through OnlineJobs.ph messaging or
. Please do not call the company’s customer phone line regarding this position.

title: Full-Time Customer Success Caller, American Accent, US Kids Coding Schools (Saturdays Required)
description:
theCoderSchool Metro Atlanta runs four coding, AI and robotics schools for kids ages 5 to 18 in Georgia, USA. Families pay monthly for weekly lessons, and we want every family to feel looked after so their kids keep learning with us for years.



THE JOB

You are the friendly voice our current families hear from. You call parents at the moments that matter, catch problems early, and keep families happy and enrolled. You work from a daily list we prepare for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call new families before and after their child's first lesson, then again at 30, 60 and 90 days

- Call or text the same day a student misses a lesson, and book the make-up class

- Call families when their child's coach changes, and introduce the new coach

- Call within 24 hours when a family asks to cancel, offer the options we give you (a pause, a new day or time, a new coach, a group class), and write down the real reason

- Call families whose plan is ending or whose card payment failed, before their lessons stop

- Walk parents through their child's progress report

- Send parents short updates (a screenshot or video of what their child built) from the coaches' notes, and remind coaches when notes are missing

- Send birthday messages, and notes at 6 months and 1 year

- Ask happy families for referrals and Google reviews

- Call families who left a few months ago to invite them back

- Tell current families about camps and workshops first

- Log every call in our booking system (Pike13) and send a short end-of-day report

- On Saturdays, cover the phones and texts for all 4 schools together with our other front desk teammate



SCHEDULE (US EASTERN TIME)

Monday to Thursday, 10:30 AM to 7:00 PM, and Saturday, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM (40 hours a week). Fridays and Sundays off. This is a night shift in the Philippines.



PAY

$3.50 to $4 USD an hour, paid weekly through OnlineJobs EasyPay (Payoneer). Raise after 90 days.



MUST HAVE

- Saturday availability, 9 AM to 3 PM Eastern, every week

- A clear, natural American English accent

- 2+ years of phone work with American customers (customer success, account management, retention or support)

- A warm, patient manner with parents, and calm when someone is upset

- Good with booking or CRM software

- A quiet room, a good headset, reliable internet, and backup power and internet

- A verified Payoneer account, or one set up before your first payday



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with schools, tutoring or kids' activities

- Pike13, Mindbody or similar booking software



PRIVACY

You will see children's and families' information. You must keep it private and sign an NDA.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words "Happy Families". We skip applications without them.

2. Record a 1-minute voice clip (Vocaroo, Loom or Google Drive). Pretend you're calling a parent whose child just had their first coding lesson: say hello, ask how it went, and wrap up the call. Then tell us about your customer service experience. Send the link.

3. Tell us your hourly rate, whether you can work Monday to Thursday 10:30 AM to 7 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 3 PM Eastern, and your backup plan for internet and power.



Finalists do a paid $15 test: a few short recorded practice calls, including a parent who wants to cancel.
