title: SEO, Google Ads & Apollo Specialist Using Claude
description:
We are two small North American B2B manufacturers selling to architects, contractors and facility managers. You would split your week between both companies, working alongside a full-time teammate who already knows our SEO work.



This is a hands-on marketing role. 

You will do the real work: apply SEO changes, run Google Ads campaigns and launch Apollo outreach. 

What is different is how: we use Claude to do the heavy, time-consuming parts (audits, analysis, drafts, prospect filtering), so you spend your time on decisions and execution instead of repetitive manual work. You review what Claude produces, correct it, and are accountable for what goes live.



What you will do

- SEO: run daily and weekly audits with Claude (indexing, titles and meta descriptions, broken links, rankings in Search Console and Semrush), then make the fixes yourself in Wix and Shopify: titles, metadata, image alt text, internal links, redirects and page content. You also keep a change log.

- Google Ads: manage our Search campaigns. You use Claude to review search terms, performance and ad copy, then apply the changes yourself: negative keywords, ad text, bids and budgets, new ad groups. You track results and explain them.

- Apollo prospecting: build prospect lists, use Claude to pre-filter them, check the first contacts by hand, then set up and launch the sequences. You follow up on replies and keep Apollo and our CRM data clean.

- Reporting: write a short end-of-day report in your own words, with numbers and links, and keep our Trello board current.



Tools you will use: Claude, Google Search Console, Semrush, Google Ads, Apollo, Wix and Shopify , Google Sheets, Trello. 

You do not need to know them all. Tell us honestly what you know.



What we are looking for

- Real hands-on experience executing in at least two of these: SEO, Google Ads, B2B prospecting.

- Daily practice with Claude and the discipline to verify its output before acting on it.

- Careful, detail-oriented, and honest about what you have and have not done. Saying “I haven’t done this yet” will not disqualify you. Claiming experience you don’t have will.

- Clear written English (C2 minimum)

- Comfortable working as part of a pair, and asking questions.



Schedule and terms

Full-time, 35-40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Compensation: depending on experience, with reviews based on results, skills demonstrated and commitment to the project. We value long-term relationships and want to grow with the right person.

At least 4 hours of overlap with Eastern Time, and availability for early-morning Eastern Time meetings.



To apply, please answer these questions in your own words (short and specific):

- Tell us about a time Claude gave you a wrong or weak result. What was wrong, and how did you catch it?

- Describe an SEO task you did yourself in Wix or Shopify. What did you change, and how did you check the result?

- What have you personally done in Google Ads ? Which parts have you not done?

- You have 500 prospects exported from Apollo. How would you use Claude to filter them, and what would you verify manually before launching a sequence?

- For each tool, say “never”, “basic” or “used regularly”: Search Console, Semrush, Apollo, Wix, Shopify, Google Ads.

- Send us proof of your own work: a link to a portfolio, a report, or a short screen recording (Loom or similar, 3 minutes max). Show a real task you did yourself in SEO, Google Ads or Apollo, using Claude if you did. We want to see what you changed and what the result was, not a general description. Please add 2 or 3 sentences stating which parts you did personally and which parts the team or the client did. Statements like “I did SEO for a client” without a link or a concrete example will not be considered.

- Can you attend early-morning Eastern Time meetings? What is your ideal schedule, your expected rate in USD, and your earliest start date?



Applications that skip the questions or paste generic or AI-copied answers will not move forward.

title: Customer Service E-commerce (Fluent English, Weekend Availability Required)
description:
Are YOU an experienced customer service representative who can read the emotion behind a two-line
 and respond like a real, warm, thinking human being — not a copy-pasted bot reply? Can you handle a chargeback dispute on a digital product and actually have a shot at winning it, knowing exactly what evidence matters when there's no tracking number or delivery signature to show? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.

We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and digital education space, including a growing catalog of craft and DIY digital products, selling primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our support team and take full ownership of the post-purchase customer experience.

We need someone to take responsibility for:

Inbox Ownership: Handling our daily support inbox end-to-end — order access issues, missing downloads, billing questions, refund requests, and general product questions — as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand.

Retention-First Problem Solving: Before ever processing a refund, identifying and offering the right retention or bonus-bundle offer per our SOP. A refund is always the last resort, not the first move.

Chargeback & Dispute Defense: Responding to chargebacks and payment disputes on digital products with the right evidence (delivery confirmation, access logs, communication history, terms accepted at checkout) — you understand this is a different game than physical-product disputes, and you know a genuinely high win-rate claim doesn't exist in this space.

Template Adaptation, Not Scripting: We provide a complete SOP with
 templates for every common scenario. Your job is to use them as a base and adapt the tone naturally to each customer — never robotic, never obviously AI-generated or copy-pasted.

Escalation Judgment: Knowing exactly when a situation (legal threat, unusual request outside our templates, a case that just doesn't smell right) needs to be flagged to us instead of improvised.

Daily Reporting: Keeping a simple log of ticket volume and any recurring issues you notice, so we can fix problems at the source.

Position Requirements:

At least 2 years of specific customer service experience for digital products — not physical/shipping-based ecommerce. You must know the practical difference between a refund and a chargeback, and have direct experience responding to disputes where a tracking number isn't an option.

Fluent English, 9/10 or above: natural, native-sounding phrasing — not translated-sounding sentences. As part of the application, you'll be asked to record a short 60-second video or voice response to a question you haven't seen in advance. This isn't optional — written answers alone won't be considered.

A real thinking mind, not an AI-generated response: we will read your written answers closely, and generic, overly polished, ChatGPT-flavored replies will be filtered out immediately. We want your judgment, not a prompt's.

Comfortable with our tools: Google Drive (sharing, permissions, troubleshooting access errors), PDF delivery, and a shared support inbox/helpdesk.

Availability & Commitment: This role requires coverage 7 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday — no exceptions, no "9-to-5, Monday-Friday" mentality. Minimum 3 hours/day, structured as short check-ins spread across your day (morning / afternoon / evening, your own local time zone). Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working, and would you see this growing toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: correct order numbers, correct links, zero copy-paste mistakes in a customer's name or order details. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team.

What We Offer:

title: Engineering Works Planner - Salesforce Field Service (UK Fire & Security Company)
description:
ABOUT US

Briggs Fire & Security Ltd is a family-owned UK fire and security services company, established in 1985 and headquartered in Exeter, England. We maintain fire alarm, emergency lighting, security and life safety systems at over 36,000 sites across the UK, with a team of 150+ staff including more than 115 directly employed field engineers.



We are looking for an experienced Engineering Works Planner to join our Operations team. You will plan our engineers' weeks and get the right engineer to the right site at the right time, working day to day in the Salesforce Field Service Console and Service Console.



THE ROLE

You will own the planning of engineers and jobs across your UK regions: building efficient schedules for planned maintenance, reactive callouts and minor works, keeping engineers productive and making sure every job meets its deadline.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Plan and schedule field engineer work (planned maintenance/PPM, reactive callouts and minor works) using the Salesforce Field Service Console (dispatcher console / Gantt)

- Manage work orders, service appointments and cases in the Salesforce Service Console

- Build full, efficient engineer schedules: minimise travel, group jobs geographically and maximise completed jobs per engineer per day

- Match jobs to engineers by skills, location, availability and site requirements

- Plan ahead to meet SLAs and due dates, and re-plan quickly when jobs overrun, cancel or new urgent work comes in

- Coordinate with engineers, account managers, booking coordinators and customers on timings and changes

- Keep appointments, work orders and statuses accurate and up to date in Salesforce

- Proactively flag capacity gaps, scheduling conflicts and at-risk jobs to the Operations team



ABOUT YOU

Essential:

- Proven hands-on experience with the Salesforce Field Service Console (dispatcher console / Gantt) and Salesforce Service Console

- Proven experience planning field engineers and scheduling jobs, ideally for a field service, facilities management or building maintenance business

- Strong logical and geographic reasoning to balance travel, priority, skills and SLAs across multiple engineers

- Excellent written and spoken English for clear, professional communication with UK engineers and customers

- Highly organised with strong attention to detail, and calm under pressure when plans change

- Reliable, punctual and able to work UK business hours consistently

- Stable high-speed internet, a quiet home workspace, a good-quality headset and a reliable computer



Nice to have:

- Experience planning for UK or US clients

- Knowledge of fire, security or building services maintenance

- Experience with Salesforce Field Service scheduling optimisation, territories and resource absences



WORKING HOURS

- Full time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

- UK business hours (approximately 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM Philippine time during UK summer, and 4:00 PM to 1:00 AM during UK winter)



SALARY

USD $750 per month



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, please send:

1. Your CV/resume

2. A short video recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and describing your engineer planning experience

3. A brief note on your experience with the Salesforce Field Service Console and Service Console, including how many engineers you have planned for



Note - Applications without a video recording will not be considered.

title: Online Group Facilitator: Wellbeing & Connection Sessions (Zoom, Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Do you love deep conversations, bringing people together, and helping others feel heard?



WeSangha is a new wellness startup that brings small groups of people together on Zoom for guided conversations. Think of it like a kumustahan or recollection sharing session, but online with 2 to 6 people: sharing, listening, and reflection exercises that help people connect beyond small talk. We're looking for a warm, people-loving facilitator to host these sessions and grow with us long-term.



No special certification needed. We'll train you on the exact exercises and scripts. What matters most is who you are: kind, calm, curious about people, and genuinely interested in personal growth.



What you'll do

- Host live Zoom sessions for pairs and small groups (5–6 people), following a guided script

- Welcome participants, explain the group agreements, keep time, and guide each exercise

- Create a safe, respectful space where people feel comfortable sharing

- Gently support anyone who gets emotional and follow our safety guidelines

- Write short notes after each session on what worked and how people felt

- Help improve our exercises and test a new guided-session app we're building

- Help invite and follow up with participants



You'll be a great fit if you

- Love people and conversations that go deeper than small talk

- Stay calm and kind when someone shares something emotional

- Are on your own personal growth journey (journaling, meditation, therapy, retreats, coaching, faith-based reflection, anything)

- Speak clear, natural English and are comfortable on camera

- Are reliable, organized, and good at following a structure

- Have stable internet, a quiet space, and a laptop with a webcam

- Can work some evening or night hours (Philippine time) for international participants



Experience that helps (not required)

- Leading retreats, recollections, youth or campus ministry, or small groups (formator experience welcome)

- Kumustahan, psychosocial support, or Psychological First Aid (PFA) training

- Peer support, mental health advocacy, or community volunteering

- Psychology, guidance counseling, HR training, or coaching background

- Yoga, meditation, or mindfulness teaching

- Hosting workshops, webinars, or online communities



This is NOT therapy. You won't diagnose or counsel anyone. We give you clear guidelines and a referral path for anyone who needs professional help.



Pay and hours

- Part-time to start (about 15–20 hours/week), with room to grow into full-time

- Fixed monthly salary, paid on time every month. Tell us your expected rate in your application.

- Long-term role. You'll work directly with the founder and help shape the program from the start.

- Paid trial session before you start



How to apply

Fill out the short application here: 

Include a 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and sharing a time you helped someone feel heard.

Put "I love deep conversations" at the top of your application so we know you read this post.

title: Bankruptcy Case Manager (US Law Firm) - Trustee Documents & Deadlines
description:
READ THIS FIRST

To apply, start your message with the word TRUSTEE and answer the four questions at the end. Applications that skip this get deleted unread. This job is about following instructions exactly and on time, so the application is the first test.



WHO WE ARE

Van Horn Law Group, P.A. is a bankruptcy law firm in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. We file Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 consumer and business cases in four federal court districts. About 100 people work here, including 15 attorneys. We have been doing this for over a decade and we file cases every single week.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

After we file a client's bankruptcy case, the trustee starts asking for documents on a deadline, and you are the person who makes sure every single one arrives on time.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Own a caseload of filed Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 cases from the filing date all the way to discharge.

Track every trustee document request and every court deadline on your cases. Nothing gets lost, nothing gets late.

Chase clients by
, text and phone until the documents actually arrive. Politely, persistently, and without letting anything sit.

Assemble and submit document packages to the trustees through their portals.

Get clients ready for their 341 meeting of creditors so they show up on time, with ID, knowing what to expect.

Confirm the required credit counseling and financial management courses are completed and the certificates are in the file.

Escalate to the supervising attorney the moment a deadline looks at risk. Early and often. We would much rather hear about a problem a week out than the day after.

Keep every case status current in our system so anyone can see where a file stands in ten seconds.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Follow up is the entire job. We need someone who cannot stand an open item. If a client ignores three
s, you find another way to reach them. If a document looks wrong, you catch it before the trustee does. If a deadline is six days out, it is already on your mind.

This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. Cases fall apart quietly when nobody is chasing, and a missed deadline can get a client's case dismissed. That is why this job matters and why we pay well for it.

You should be comfortable being the calm, organized person telling a stressed client for the fourth time that we still need their bank statement, and having them thank you for it.



REQUIRED

At least 2 years chasing documents, payments or information from people against a deadline. US law firm, collections, insurance claims follow up, medical billing and accounts receivable, mortgage processing, or title work all count. US bankruptcy experience is a big plus but it is not required.

Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on the phone and on
 with US clients every day.

A real system for tracking deadlines. In your application, tell us what it is.

Available during US Eastern business hours.

A reliable computer, backup power, a quiet place to take calls, and stable internet of at least 25 Mbps. We will ask for a speed test screenshot.

Able to sign a confidentiality agreement and work inside our secure systems. Our clients' financial information never leaves them.



IMPORTANT ABOUT THIS ROLE

You will never give clients legal advice. You collect documents, confirm dates, explain our process, and route every legal question to an attorney. We will train you on exactly where that line sits, and we take it seriously.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience with Chapter 7 or Chapter 13 trustee document requests.

Experience with 341 meeting preparation.

Experience with a US law firm case management system.



WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive monthly salary in USD, paid on time, every time.

Paid time off plus Philippine holidays.

HMO after the probationary period.

Full paid training on US bankruptcy procedure and our systems. If you have the discipline, we will teach you the law part.

Real advancement. Our senior Philippine team members lead other people and are paid accordingly.

A long-term seat. We are hiring someone we expect to still be here in five years.



SALARY

We pay at the top of that range for someone who has done US bankruptcy post-filing work before.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word TRUSTEE. Then answer these four questions in your own words. Please do not use AI to write your answers. We read a lot of these and we can tell.

1. Describe a job where you were responsible for chasing people for documents, payments or information on a deadline. How many were you handling at once, and exactly how did you track them?

2. A client has ignored three
s and one phone call, and the document is due in four days. Walk us through exactly what you do next, step by step.

3. What tools have you used to track deadlines and case status, and what did you like or dislike about them?

4. What hours can you work in Philippine time, and are you comfortable being on the phone with US clients?

Attach your resume and tell us your expected monthly salary in USD. We reply to every applicant who follows these instructions.

title: Client Documents Coordinator (US Bankruptcy Law Firm) - Pre-Filing Document Collection

Someone who cannot stand a missing page. If a client sends a blurry photo, you catch it before the prep team does. If a client goes quiet, you find another way to reach them. You can be the calm, organized person asking a stressed client for the same bank statement a third time and have them thank you for it.

 with US clients every day.

You will never give clients legal advice. You collect documents, explain our process, and route every legal question to an attorney. We train you on exactly where that line sits.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience with Glade, Clio, Best Case or another case management system. Familiarity with bank statements, pay stubs and tax returns. Spanish is a plus.



WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive monthly salary in USD, paid on time. Paid time off plus Philippine holidays. HMO after the probationary period. Full paid training on our systems and US bankruptcy procedure. Real advancement. A long-term seat.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word DOCUMENTS. Then answer these four questions in your own words. Please do not use AI to write your answers.

3. What tools have you used to track document status, and what did you like or dislike about them?

title: AI Fashion Video Creator for TikTok Shop (Short Silent Videos)
description:
I run TikTok Shop accounts in Thailand and I'm looking for someone to create short AI-generated fashion product videos for me.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Create silent, music-driven vertical (9:16) videos, 8 to 12 seconds long, using AI video and virtual try-on tools

- Recreate viral TikTok Shop fashion videos (US or any market) from reference links I send: same hook, pacing and structure

- Use our real product photos and clips so color, fit and fabric look accurate

- Use the AI avatar I provide (an Asian woman). Do not create or use any real person's likeness

- Deliver ready-to-post videos through Google Drive and make quick revisions when asked



WHAT I HANDLE

- Reference videos, product photos and key benefits

- Thai text overlays, music choice and posting



TIKTOK SHOP AI CONTENT RULES (REQUIRED)

Every video must follow TikTok Shop's current AI-generated content policy. At minimum:

- The product must be shown accurately (true color, fit, fabric, details). No misleading visuals

- Videos that are fully or heavily AI-generated must be clearly marked as AI, so build them so they can be labeled as AI-generated

- No fake reviews, fabricated endorsements, invented results or exaggerated claims

- No real person's face or voice used without their permission, and no celebrity or lookalike likeness

- No AI-generated voices or fake narration passed off as a real person

- Every video must have real motion. No static slideshows, still images or looping clips

- No copyrighted or trademarked material (logos, characters, brand footage) that we don't own

If you are unsure whether something is allowed, ask me before making it. Videos that break these rules will not be accepted.



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience making AI product, fashion or UGC-style videos (portfolio required)

- Skilled with AI video tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo or similar) and CapCut or similar editing

- Familiar with TikTok Shop's AI content policy, or willing to read it before starting



VOLUME

Start with 1 video a day, with room to grow if results are good.



PAID TRIAL

First 3 videos are a paid trial so we can see your quality and workflow.



TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER

1. Which AI video and try-on tools do you use?

2. Link 2 or 3 AI fashion or product videos you've made.

3. How do you make sure your videos follow TikTok Shop's AI content rules?

4. How long does it take you to turn a reference video into a finished one?

5. What is your monthly rate for 1 video a day?

title: YouTube Video Editor – Business Documentaries & Explainer Videos

We're based in Las Vegas and serve clients nationwide.

We recently rebranded and are launching an aggressive social media and marketing campaign. We need someone to manage our AI-powered content creation and social media operations so our founder can focus on tax preparation and business strategy.



THE ROLE

You will manage:



AI content generation tools (image, video, copy)

You will NOT be responsible for:

, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, and TikTok

)

+ pieces of content per week

2+ years experience managing social media accounts (business, not personal)

Strong written English (captions, replies, engagement)

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision

Reliable internet and computer setup

Available during U.S. business hours (at least 4-5 hour overlap with Pacific Time)



Experience We're Looking For:



Managing multiple social media platforms simultaneously

Using AI to generate images, graphics, or designs

Using AI to generate or edit written content

Creating AI avatars/clones for video content

Working with brand guidelines and style guides





APPLICATION QUESTIONS (Required)

List ALL the AI tools you have used for work (not just heard of). For each tool, briefly describe what you used it for and how often.

 AI image/graphic generation tools

 AI avatar/clone creation tools

 Any other AI tools

 follower count.

] with subject line: "AI Social Media Manager — [Your Name]"

title: Director of International Brands & Retail Markets
description:
Location: Philippines, with local and international travel as needed

Employment type: Full-time, Contract to Hire



Solvera is recruiting on behalf of a US-headquartered client with operations across the United States and ASEAN. With an established presence in the Philippines, our client is expanding its portfolio of international brands, products, and supply solutions across consumer, institutional, and commercial markets.



We are seeking a commercially accomplished Director of International Brands & Retail Markets to lead brand acquisition, partnerships, market entry, and retail expansion.



This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can identify brands with strong market potential, negotiate sound commercial agreements, and build the channels and operating discipline needed to deliver profitable growth.



The Opportunity

You will lead the development and performance of the international brands and retail portfolio, from identifying potential partners and securing commercial rights through launch, distribution, and ongoing growth.



Working closely with executive leadership, you will develop the portfolio strategy, build retail and distribution relationships, and make investment recommendations supported by clear commercial analysis.



Key responsibilities

1) Portfolio strategy and international brand partnerships

Develop the portfolio strategy, identifying priority categories, brands, customer segments, and markets.

Identify and engage international brand owners seeking representation or expansion in the Philippines and selected ASEAN markets.

Evaluate distribution, licensing, franchise, and other commercial partnership opportunities.

Prepare business cases covering market demand, competition, pricing, investment requirements, risks, and expected returns.

Lead negotiations on territory, exclusivity, distribution and channel rights, purchase commitments, marketing support, payment terms, and performance obligations.

Assess partner credibility, supply reliability, product suitability, and contractual risks with Finance, Legal, and Operations.

Build strong relationships with international principals and monitor delivery against agreed commitments.

Recommend when to invest, expand, renegotiate, reposition, or exit a brand.



2) Market entry and brand development

Develop market-entry plans covering positioning, assortment, pricing, route to market, launch investment, and financial targets.

Translate international brand standards into locally relevant commercial execution.

Coordinate product readiness, regulatory requirements, supply arrangements, marketing, and channel activation.

Establish launch milestones, budgets, ownership, and performance measures.

Use customer insights, sales data, and competitor analysis to refine product selection and positioning.

Evaluate expansion into selected ASEAN markets, accounting for differences in demand, regulation, distribution, and channel economics.

Manage brand performance beyond launch, with attention to sustained sales, repeat demand, and viable margins.



3) Retail, distribution, and channel growth

Develop the appropriate mix of retail, wholesale, distribution, e-commerce, marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and institutional channels.

Build and maintain relationships with retail groups, distributors, commercial partners, and strategic accounts.

Negotiate listings, trading terms, promotions, and channel agreements that support profitable growth.

Set channel-specific pricing, assortment, service standards, and performance expectations.

Evaluate physical retail opportunities against location economics, investment requirements, payback, and operating capacity.

Maintain pricing discipline and manage channel conflict.

Improve sales productivity, sell-through, customer retention, and repeat purchasing.

Coordinate institutional or government opportunities with the relevant commercial and bidding teams.



4) Financial and commercial management

Own the portfolio’s P&L, annual business plan, budgets, and forecasts.

Set and deliver targets for revenue, gross margin, contribution, operating profit, and working capital.

Assess landed costs, foreign-exchange exposure, trade spending, promotional returns, and channel profitability.

Lead demand and inventory planning with Supply Chain, Sales, and Finance.

Monitor stock availability, inventory ageing, stock cover, returns, markdowns, and obsolescence.

Recommend allocation of capital and resources based on expected returns and execution capacity.

Review results against approved business cases and take corrective action where required.

Present clear performance reports, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.



5) Leadership and execution

Build and lead the commercial team as the portfolio grows.

Establish clear responsibilities, decision rights, targets, and performance expectations.

Align Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations around shared priorities.

Establish processes for opportunity assessment, partner selection, launches, forecasting, and business reviews.

Set approval controls for pricing, discounts, trading terms, and investment commitments.

Develop team capability in negotiation, account management, commercial analysis, and execution.

Maintain accurate reporting and escalate material risks promptly.

Uphold contractual commitments, brand standards, and ethical business practices.



What we are looking for

At least 12 years of relevant commercial experience, including at least five years in senior leadership within branded products, retail, distribution, or a closely related business.

Demonstrated ownership of a substantial business or portfolio P&L, with measurable growth and profitability outcomes.

A proven record of securing international brand partnerships or negotiating significant distribution, licensing, or franchise agreements.

Direct responsibility for launching brands or entering new markets, including accountability for performance after launch.

Strong understanding of the Philippine retail and distribution landscape, supported by relevant commercial relationships.

Experience managing multiple brands, product categories, or channels with different commercial requirements.

Strong financial judgement across investment appraisal, pricing, margin management, inventory, and working capital.

Experience leading teams, managing budgets, and coordinating cross-functional execution.

Ability to negotiate directly with international principals and present recommendations to executive leadership.

Excellent written and spoken English.

A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Relevant postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.



Experience that will distinguish candidates

Commercial responsibility across more than one ASEAN market.

Building a brand portfolio, distribution business, or business unit from an early stage.

Negotiating directly with international brand owners and regional headquarters.

Managing both physical retail and digital channels.

Developing institutional or B2B sales alongside consumer channels.

Turning around underperforming brands, channels, or inventory positions.

Working in an entrepreneurial environment where senior leaders remain directly involved in execution.



Leadership profile: We are looking for someone who makes sound investment decisions, builds strong partnerships, and takes ownership of commercial results. You should be comfortable developing a portfolio strategy and personally leading negotiations, partner meetings, and launches. You will need the judgement to challenge assumptions, the confidence to communicate risks, and the discipline to turn plans into profitable results.



Location, work eligibility, and availability

- Available for regular working-hour overlap with US Pacific Time to collaborate with executive leadership and international partners. The agreed schedule will accommodate Pacific daylight saving changes.

Pay: Php150,000.00 - Php200,000.00 per month

Benefits:

- Commissions

- Flexible schedule

- Promotion to permanent employee

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Quezon City

title: SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR AND AI CREATIVE PRODUCER
description:
SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR AND AI CREATIVE PRODUCER

Meta Ads • DTC E-commerce | Full-Time • Remote, Philippines



********Make Ads People Want to Watch—and Act On********



SurviveX is a first-aid brand looking for a hands-on SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR AND AI CREATIVE PRODUCER 

 who can turn strong ad ideas, approved product footage, creator content, and AI-generated elements into compelling
 and Instagram ads.



This is a performance-creative role, not simply prompt generation or template editing. You should understand what makes people stop scrolling, engage with an ad, trust a product, and take action.

Company Website:  

Company
:

Our practice is built on clear communication, organized systems, and careful attention to detail. We are looking for someone who shares those priorities, enjoys legal work, and takes pride in keeping files accurate, organized, and moving forward.



About the Role



Working closely with our lawyers and law clerks, you will support residential real estate transactions from initial client intake through closing and final reporting.

- Maintain accurate, organized electronic files.

Schedule and Compensation

We look forward to hearing about your experience, your interest in legal work, and what you would bring to our team.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Part-time Administrative Assistant



Expert in CRM, Process Optimization & Precise Documentation



Hours: 10–15 hours per week, part-time and fully remote

Pay: €1.25 per hour (approx. €54–€81 per month)

Experience: At least 2 years

Growth: Room to grow over time into a managing role with your own assistants

About the Role



We are looking for an exceptionally precise and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support our Dutch consultancy team for bathroom and kitchen renovations. This is a part-time role of 10 to 15 hours per week. You will play a key role in keeping our business processes organized and efficient. From managing our CRM and scheduling appointments, to handling client communication and improving internal workflows — your work will directly impact the smooth operation of our projects.



This role requires someone who is not only accurate and reliable, but also enjoys building and improving systems that bring structure and clarity to the team. You will mainly communicate with clients and third parties in Dutch, via
 and WhatsApp, with the help of AI tools. We are a large company in the Netherlands, and our loyalty system rewards your commitment and keeps you motivated to grow with us, with salary raises and bonuses.



If you are highly structured, thrive on accuracy, and love optimizing processes, this is the role for you.



Responsibilities

Manage and update our CRM (HubSpot, moving to Bitrix24): client data, pipelines, documentation and reporting.

Handle
 and WhatsApp communication with clients and third parties — always in clear Dutch.

Schedule and prepare appointments and meetings, making sure all relevant information and documents are ready.

Maintain and organize the shared mailbox and documentation systems, making sure nothing is overlooked.

Prepare and follow up on conversations with clients, contractors and partners.

Develop and improve processes, SOPs and internal systems for better workflow and team collaboration.

Collaborate with colleagues remotely and ensure smooth communication across the team.

Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) for translations, summaries and efficiency improvements where applicable.

Build scalable systems that can later be taught to future assistants, ensuring structured onboarding and consistency.

What We're Looking For

Pietje-precies personality (Dutch for someone who gets every detail exactly right): you take pride in doing things 100% correctly, with no room for sloppy work. Slow but perfect is better than fast and messy.

Process-minded: you naturally think in steps, structure and systems. You don't just follow processes — you improve them.

Detail-obsessed: you enjoy documentation, checklists and keeping things clean and organized.

Structured thinker: you build your own methods and frameworks to stay on top of tasks and bring clarity.

Excellent communicator: strong written English for team communication, and able to write clear, correct Dutch with the help of AI tools for client communication.

Tech-savvy & adaptable: experience with CRM systems (Bitrix24 or HubSpot is a plus), Office/Google Workspace and digital tools. Comfortable learning new software quickly.

AI-friendly: able to use AI tools for translations and workflow support.

Trustworthy & discreet: reliable handling of confidential data and sensitive information.

Team player with leadership potential: willing to support colleagues now, and capable of onboarding and training future assistants later.

Experience & Background

At least 2 years of administrative or virtual assistant experience in an international or remote setting.

Experience with CRM systems (Bitrix24 or HubSpot is a strong plus).

Proven ability to manage communication with multiple stakeholders (clients, partners, contractors).

Experience in process optimization or building documentation systems (SOPs, checklists).

A background in consultancy, construction, real estate or renovation is a bonus, but not required.

Education level is flexible — we value skills, structure and precision over formal degrees.

What We Offer

A part-time, remote position of 10–15 hours per week.

(€54–€81 per month), plus a loyalty system with salary raises and bonuses.

Full support and training in our tools and workflows.

The chance to shape and improve systems that the entire company will use.

Growth opportunities: the possibility to train and lead future assistants.

A long-term role in a stable Dutch company, working closely with an international team.

How to Apply



If you are highly structured, precise, and love creating clarity and efficiency, we want to meet you. Please send us your CV (in English) along with a short motivation letter describing how your personality and skills fit this role. Also let us know your availability: how many hours per week (10–15) and on which days.

title: Customer Service E-commerce (Fluent English, Weekend Availability Required)
description:
Are YOU an experienced customer service representative who can read the emotion behind a two-line
 and respond like a real, warm, thinking human being — not a copy-pasted bot reply? Can you handle a chargeback dispute on a digital product and actually have a shot at winning it, knowing exactly what evidence matters when there's no tracking number or delivery signature to show? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.

We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and digital education space, including a growing catalog of craft and DIY digital products, selling primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our support team and take full ownership of the post-purchase customer experience.

We need someone to take responsibility for:

Inbox Ownership: Handling our daily support inbox end-to-end — order access issues, missing downloads, billing questions, refund requests, and general product questions — as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand.

Retention-First Problem Solving: Before ever processing a refund, identifying and offering the right retention or bonus-bundle offer per our SOP. A refund is always the last resort, not the first move.

Chargeback & Dispute Defense: Responding to chargebacks and payment disputes on digital products with the right evidence (delivery confirmation, access logs, communication history, terms accepted at checkout) — you understand this is a different game than physical-product disputes, and you know a genuinely high win-rate claim doesn't exist in this space.

Template Adaptation, Not Scripting: We provide a complete SOP with
 templates for every common scenario. Your job is to use them as a base and adapt the tone naturally to each customer — never robotic, never obviously AI-generated or copy-pasted.

Escalation Judgment: Knowing exactly when a situation (legal threat, unusual request outside our templates, a case that just doesn't smell right) needs to be flagged to us instead of improvised.

Daily Reporting: Keeping a simple log of ticket volume and any recurring issues you notice, so we can fix problems at the source.

Position Requirements:

At least 2 years of specific customer service experience for digital products — not physical/shipping-based ecommerce. You must know the practical difference between a refund and a chargeback, and have direct experience responding to disputes where a tracking number isn't an option.

Fluent English, 9/10 or above: natural, native-sounding phrasing — not translated-sounding sentences. As part of the application, you'll be asked to record a short 60-second video or voice response to a question you haven't seen in advance. This isn't optional — written answers alone won't be considered.

A real thinking mind, not an AI-generated response: we will read your written answers closely, and generic, overly polished, ChatGPT-flavored replies will be filtered out immediately. We want your judgment, not a prompt's.

Comfortable with our tools: Google Drive (sharing, permissions, troubleshooting access errors), PDF delivery, and a shared support inbox/helpdesk.

Availability & Commitment: This role requires coverage 7 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday — no exceptions, no "9-to-5, Monday-Friday" mentality. Minimum 3 hours/day, structured as short check-ins spread across your day (morning / afternoon / evening, your own local time zone). Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working, and would you see this growing toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: correct order numbers, correct links, zero copy-paste mistakes in a customer's name or order details. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team.

What We Offer:

A complete, ready-to-use Customer Service SOP with templates for every common scenario, plus clear escalation guidelines — you'll never be guessing.

A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment.

Career Growth: real potential to become the lead/only customer service representative across our full catalog as it expands, with performance-based rate increases and a path toward full-time.

Screening Questions (Upwork):

Please write a 3-4 sentence sample reply to this customer message: "Hi, I purchased the ebook bundle two days ago but never received the download
. Can you help?"

Have you handled disputes/chargebacks on digital products before? If so, roughly what percentage have you been able to win, and what evidence/approach did you use? (Be honest — we're checking for real experience, not a number.)

What's your current workload with other clients (hours/week), and do you see yourself moving toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

This role requires 7-day-a-week availability, minimum 3 hours/day split into short check-ins across your day — not Mon-Fri only, and not one continuous block. Please confirm you're comfortable with this on an ongoing basis, and share your proposed check-in times in your own time zone.

To Apply: Include the sample reply above directly in your application, along with a brief note on your relevant experience. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short 60-second video or voice response before moving forward.

title: Full-Time & Part-Time Customer Care & Sales Support VA (GoHighLevel)
description:
Hi! I'm Yas of HIDARI Group, a growing Canadian business optimization and implementation company.



We’re growing our customer care team to support homeowners across Western Canada as they choose and install blinds, shades, shutters, drapery, and motorized window coverings.



I’m looking for a warm, confident and highly organized Customer Care & Sales Support VA who knows GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) and loves talking to customers on the phone.



This is NOT a CRM build or automation role. The pipelines, workflows and follow-up sequences are already set up.



I’m looking for someone who can work inside that system every day: call new leads within minutes, book in-home consultations, follow up on quotes, answer customer messages, and keep every record accurate.



You will be working directly with our office team, who will train you and be your day-to-day point of contact.

Your primary goal will be simple:



Make sure no lead, customer, quote or service request falls through the cracks, and keep the consultation calendar full.

What You’ll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:



- Responding to new leads, missed calls, texts and
s within 5–10 minutes

- Calling new leads to book free in-home consultations

- Collecting and entering complete booking details (contact info, service address, number of windows, budget, products of interest, preferred date and time)

- Following up with leads who haven’t booked yet

- Calling and texting customers about open quotes after their consultation

- Answering general questions and finding out what’s holding a customer back

- Managing the CRM Conversations inbox throughout your shift

- Reviewing customer history, notes and tasks before every call or message

- Updating notes, tasks and opportunity stages after every interaction

- Responding to Google reviews with professional, personalized replies

- Tracking warranty, repair and service requests until they’re resolved

- Reviewing completed installations and closing files once every checklist is done

- Escalating pricing, complaints, warranty approvals and installation issues to the office team

- Preparing a weekly report on leads, bookings, quotes and open issues



The system already sends automated follow-ups. Your job is to add the human touch: the call, the thoughtful reply, and the follow-through.



Experience We’re Looking For: 

Hands-on GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) experience is required.



Please apply only if you have used GoHighLevel day to day: managing opportunities and pipelines, working the Conversations inbox, booking into calendars, and updating contacts, notes and tasks.



We’re specifically looking for someone with experience in appointment setting, inside sales support or customer service for North American customers, ideally in home services (window coverings, roofing, HVAC, solar, renovations or similar).



We are NOT looking for someone whose only GHL experience is building funnels or automations without talking to customers.

You should have:



- Excellent spoken English with clear, warm and confident phone communication

- Excellent written English for texts,
s and review replies

- Previous experience calling customers in Canada and/or the United States

- Previous appointment-setting or sales follow-up experience

- Daily, hands-on use of GoHighLevel/LeadConnector (pipelines, Conversations, calendars, tasks, reviews, dialer)

- Enough understanding of GHL workflows to avoid double-messaging customers or triggering the wrong automation

- Ability to handle several conversations at once without missing details

- Strong attention to detail and consistent note-taking habits

- Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs escalating

- Basic Google Sheets skills for weekly reporting

- Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power

- A quiet, professional workspace and a good-quality noise-cancelling headset



Experience with home improvement or window covering products, franchise businesses, the LeadConnector mobile app, and handling warranty or service requests is an asset.



The Person I’m Looking For



Personality matters to me.



You’ll be the voice homeowners hear when they first reach out. You’ll also be the person who makes sure they’re looked after long after their blinds are installed.



You should be friendly, patient, dependable and comfortable taking ownership. If a quote has gone quiet, I want you to follow up. If a customer mentions a problem in passing, I want you to log it and make sure someone deals with it. If a task is sitting open, I want you to close it or flag it.



I’m not looking for pushy sales tactics.



I’m looking for someone who can confidently say:

“Hi Sarah, I’m following up on the quote from your consultation last week. Did you have a chance to look it over, or are there any questions I can help with?”



From there, you should be comfortable having a real conversation, listening for what’s holding them back, and guiding them to the next step.



Hours & Position

We’re hiring for both full-time and part-time positions:



Shift

Weekdays



Mountain Time

Mon–Fri, 3:00pm–8:00pm



Philippine Time (Nov–Mar)

Tue–Sat, 6:00am–11:00am



Philippine Time (Mar–Nov)

Tue–Sat, 5:00am–10:00am



Shift

Weekends



Mountain Time

Sat–Sun, 9:00am–6:00pm



Philippine Time (Nov–Mar)

Sun–Mon, 12:00am–9:00am



Philippine Time (Mar–Nov)

Sat–Sun 11:00pm – Sun–Mon 8:00am



Philippine times move one hour earlier during North American daylight saving time.



You’ll start with 2 weeks of paid training, shadowing our office team and learning their products, policies and GoHighLevel setup. You’ll then manage the role alongside them.



The busy season runs March to August, so you’ll be fully trained and confident before the volume picks up.

This position will initially begin as a 3-month pilot, with the opportunity to become a long-term role if we’re a great fit and the position is producing results.



A confidentiality agreement and security training are required before you start.



How to Apply: 

Please don’t send me a generic application. I’d genuinely like to learn a little about you.

In your application, please answer the following:



1. How many years have you used GoHighLevel/LeadConnector, and which features did you use daily?

2. Have you called or messaged customers in Canada or the United States? Please explain what you were doing.

3. What industries have you supported (home services, real estate, healthcare, etc.)?

4. Roughly how many appointments were you booking in a typical week?

5. A customer received a quote a week ago and hasn’t replied. What would you say when you call them?

6. How would you reply to a 2-star Google review that says the installer arrived late?

7. Are you applying for the full-time or part-time position? Which shift(s) can you cover, and do you have backup internet and 

power?

8. Please include a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you’d be good at this position.

9. Please send your updated CV or portfolio for our reference.
